taste.name: Footage is the only pigment
taste.trigger: When the product being sold is generated video
taste.decision: Chose grayscale chrome (#18191B hero field, #F8F8F8 canvas, #212121 text, every button a white alpha) over a brand accent color in the UI
taste.reason: Any saturated UI color sits next to the clips and color-casts them; with zero chrome color, the only warm or saturated pixels on the page are the model's output, so every hue the visitor notices is a demo
evidence: accent candidates are #212121 / #FCFCFD / white alphas only
mode chips rgba(0,0,0,0.45) instead of a colored badge

taste.name: The hero speaks once, at the bottom
taste.trigger: When the first screen is a moving image
taste.decision: Chose one 100px headline + one 16px sentence + three equal pills anchored in the bottom 268px over a centered hero with eyebrow, bullets, stats or badges
taste.reason: Text in the upper 70% of a video frame covers the subject; anchoring all copy to the lower-left gutter keeps faces and action readable and makes the type feel like a film title card rather than an ad
evidence: content block top 632px, height 268px on a 900px viewport
no eyebrow, no feature list, no numbers above the fold

taste.name: Prove with paired clips, not paragraphs
taste.trigger: When explaining each capability (length, reference, editing, production)
taste.decision: Chose one 32px title + one 16px sentence (max 780px) + a horizontal carousel of 600px-tall input→output video cards over icon/feature grids or long copy
taste.reason: A visitor trusts a reference image beside its generated result more than any adjective; the copy only names the capability, the card pair shows it
evidence: 4 sections, each exactly h1 32/500/44 + one paragraph 16/400/20
Prompt/Reference panel shown beside the output; R2V/T2V chips 14px, radius 4px

taste.name: Glass only where something moves behind it
taste.trigger: When choosing button material across a dark video act and a light gallery act
taste.decision: Chose translucent blurred pills (white 20%, blur 12px, inset top highlight) only over the hero video, and flat solid #F7F8FA circles on the light canvas, over one button style everywhere
taste.reason: Blur only reads as material when there is motion to blur; on a flat #F8F8F8 field it would be invisible cost, so the page drops it the moment the video ends
evidence: hero buttons rgba(255,255,255,0.2) + backdrop-filter blur(12px) + 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)
